name: com.mandarelabs/mandare
description: Accountability door for AI agent fleets: verify the tamper-evident ledger, check budgets, issue passports/mandates/tokens, kill a runaway agent — local-first, offline-capable.

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_LEDGER_DB
environment_variables.description: Path to the Mandare ledger database this MCP server verifies and kills against

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_MCP_HOME
environment_variables.description: Directory where issued artifacts (mandates, credentials, token grant files) are written

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_WITNESS_URL
environment_variables.description: Witness server URL — enables truncation/rewrite checks and certificate export

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_WITNESS_PUBLIC_KEY
environment_variables.description: The witness's Ed25519 public key (64 hex chars), obtained out-of-band

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_GATEWAY_URL
environment_variables.description: Running gateway base URL — enables the gateway health tool

environment_variables.name: MANDARE_MCP_ALLOW_REINSTATE
environment_variables.description: Set to 1 to expose the reinstate tool (off by default; kills only close doors)
